description: An easy-to-read translation that favours original meaning over church jargon
notes: This is the Readers’ Version of the Open English Translation with a few changes. Well-known names of people and places use their familiar traditional spellings (such as Jesus and Moses instead of Yeshua and Mosheh), using the Berean Standard Bible as a guide where it wasn’t clear which name was meant. Less familiar names keep the translator’s spelling. Notes explaining the original spellings have been removed, as have the book introductions and cross-references. Books have their usual English names, and words like ‘God’ and ‘Jesus’ are no longer specially formatted. Everything else is as the translator wrote it, including the name ‘Yahweh’ and British spelling.
